§5§lTHE §lINTAKE§r With a lattice, all the gas the rim hatches give in a second is the §9intake§r, up to§9 5× the Eddington feed§r: per SM, 25 L/t of Hydrogen, 50 of Helium or 100 of Raw Stellar Plasma. The GUI's stacked bar spends it in order:
- §9Disc§r (white): f × Eddington, the only part that moves E;
- §9Hold-up§r (amber): 3 × x × Eddington, x your place in the band (0 at the safe limit, 1 at the top). It holds mass and grows nothing;
- §9Growth§r (green): the rest. It grows the hole with the same mass per litre as the disc.
So put in more gas than f draws. At the cap, with f 1 at a safe limit, the hole grows§9 5×§r as fast as the disc alone.

§5§lPOWER§r Past 4,096 SM the output grows as the square root of mass: §9×2 at 16,384 SM§r (2.0e17 EU/t), ×4 at 65,536 (3.9e17), ×7.9 at 262,144 (7.7e17), then flattening toward ×31 (3.0e18 EU/t) at the L4 top.
